name: Gentle

abilityDetails.Daunted: Rakibin özel saldırılar sonrasında hasar almasını kolaylaştırır.
abilityDetails.Fear: Unblockable yetenek doğruluğunu sabit %100 azaltır ve Mükemmel Blok Şansını kaldırır.
abilityDetails.Physical Resistance: Fiziksel hasarlı saldırı ve yeteneklerden gelen hasarı azaltır.
abilityDetails.Reverb: Bu şampiyonun vuruşları, verilen hasara dayalı ek fiziksel hasar patlaması verir.
abilityDetails.Unstoppable: Saldırılar sırasında sersemleme ve geri itilmeye karşı bağışıklık sağlar.

howToPlay: Bu şampiyona karşı (savunmada): Garanti kritik veya 2sn içinde 2 kritikle vurulunca 20sn süren, cooldown'suz bir pasif kazanır (kritik vurmayı tamamen engeller) — hasar efektli şampiyon şart. Her 15 vuruşta 3sn pasif durdurulamaz olur, bu özel saldırı sırasında bile aktif. Yavaşlatma veya durdurulamaz-karşıtı mekanikler (Resilience gibi) iyi ama hasar efekti de taşımalı.
bestUse: Bu şampiyon genel maceralarda ve Mutant sınıfı avantajı olan yollarda en iyi performansı gösterir.
signatureAbility:
Vibranium Tattoos
Reduce the health lost when finishing a Special Attack at max stack of Muscle Mass by [5 - 50]%. While Unstoppable this damage reduction is increased by 50%.
While Unstoppable, Special Attacks cost [1 - 10]% less Power. This potency is doubled against Skill Champions.
Gain +[27.78 - 56.11] Block Penetration per Muscle Mass.

abilitySections.title: Always Active
content: Gentle is Immune to Bleed, and while performing a Well-Timed Block he is Immune to Stun.
When an Immunity triggers, or when the Opponent Purifies or Cleanses a Debuff, gain a Pursuit Passive for 15 seconds.
When Critically Hit through Block, struck by a Guaranteed Critical Hit, or if struck by 2 Critical Hits within 2 seconds of each other, gain a Reinforce Passive for 20 seconds.

abilitySections.title: Unstoppable
content: When either Champion's Combo Meter passes a multiple of 15, gain an Unstoppable Passive for 3 seconds.

When the Opponent Purifies or Cleanses a Stun Debuff, or triggers a Stun Immunity, gain Unstoppable and Indestructible Passives for 2 seconds. This effect has a 5 seconds cooldown, and the Opponent's Special Attack 3 removes the Indestructible.

abilitySections.title: Muscle Mass - Max: 12
content: When striking with or being struck by Basic Attacks, Gentle has a 31.8% chance to gain Muscle Mass, granting +[754.72]. Attack Rating for 15 seconds, paused during Special Attacks.
For each active Muscle Mass, inflict a 5% Daunted Passive.
When struck and when starting a Combo against a non-Stunned Opponent, Muscle Mass is paused for the duration of the Combo, plus 4 seconds if it was a 5-Hit Combo.
Heavy Attacks pause Muscle Mass for 3 seconds. This effect has a 15 second cooldown if striking a Stunned Opponent.
Gentle's fourth  Light Attack does not grant Muscle Mass but consumes one Muscle Mass to inflict a [8,183.7] Rupture Debuff for 15 seconds. Max: 3.

At max Muscle Mass, inflict an extra 60% Daunted Passive, but Gentle loses 10% of his Base Health when finishing a Special Attack. Gentle does not benefit from the Recoil Mastery, but each point increases this Daunted's potency by +10% flat.

abilitySections.title: Special Attacks
content: Pause Unstoppable effects for the duration of the Special Attack. This pause does not trigger against Tech Champions.
While Unstoppable,gain +[4,546.5] Attack Rating.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 1
content: The final hit inflicts a Fear Passive for 15 seconds.
When this attack ends, gain 5 Muscle Mass.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 2
content: For the duration of this Special Attack gain +[5,500] Critical Rating, but Critical Damage Rating is reduced by 50%.
On activation, gain a non-stacking 25% Reverb Passive for 15 seconds and refresh any personal Fear Passives
When this attack ends, gain non-stacking [11,000] Physical Resistance Passive for 20 seconds, or 30 seconds as Defender.

abilitySections.title: Special Attack 3
content: On activation, gain a non-stacking 35% Reverb Passive for 25 seconds.
Gain 12 Muscle Mass.
